scope: Survey-grounded AI4AI catalog organized as Benchmarks, Harness Design, and Model Design.
overlap_policy: A paper may appear in multiple public collections but only once within each collection.
citation_policy: For papers indexed as multiple versions, retain the largest title-verified count reported by the configured sources.
year_grouping: All yearly rankings use first public appearance year; a later venue year never moves a paper into a newer cohort.

research_refresh.note: Screened 1,936 unique recent cs.AI/cs.CL titles, then reconciled 145 candidate primary pages including official lab-page follow-ups: 136 added, 9 out of scope. Overlapped the trailing 30 days and checked the interval since Oct 22, with older omissions backfilled. Explicit v1 histories determine first-public dates. Two paper-reported code URLs return authenticated 404 and remain unavailable.

metrics_refresh.note: OpenAlex counts are title-checked. Network failures were retried using previous verified endpoints and independent title search. Unresolved known counts retain older values; unknown citations stay null. Semantic Scholar returned HTTP 429. All active GitHub repositories were refreshed with the authenticated REST API. Two newly paper-reported repositories return authenticated HTTP 404 and have no active code link or fabricated star count. On Oct 26, the four additions from issues #3–#6 were also title-verified against OpenAlex and their official GitHub repositories; all four indexed citation counts are zero, and repository stars were checked on Oct 26.
